edits.before: This is the genuine V2 successor to immutable859957 and its e22fa formal M1 HOLD. Only own Source/Root/config/output identities and the fatal classification changed. Original fixture/WIT/native80 frame and c365 API/actual artifact roles stay unchanged. The old expected-fatal classifier is never called by this implementation; old Source/HOLD/correction are authenticated as DATA.
edits.after: This family preserves the corrected V2 fatal classification from immutable1cda/42ed and the older859957/e22fa M1 history. V3 adds the compiler-options publication boundary in genuine new Source/Root/config/output contexts. Original fixture/WIT/native80 frame and c365 API/actual artifact roles stay unchanged. The old expected-fatal classifier is never called by this implementation; old Source/HOLD/correction are authenticated as DATA.

V3 publication boundary: immutable1cda/42ed and the actual50606 resource mapping failure remain historical DATA. That failed phase retained mapped bytes/audit but published no result/index/completion and admitted no application import. Pinned Jco prepOpts mutates its supplied options, including an own undefined field; attribution of the historical field remains a Source inference because post-call options were not captured. V3 validates exact own request properties and physical standard-shim URLs, durably writes requested-mapping-options.json before importing/calling Jco, and supplies a separate plain mutable work object with its own deep-copied map. The result mappingOptions is always the pristine frozen snapshot. A typed post-call own-property shape retains undefined/accessors without invoking getters, deleting fields, sanitizing the work object or claiming that post-call data was input. Actual mapped output still needs a new independent complete-publication DATA review before generated import.

The new options regression uses only a synthetic mutating fake function, real DurableOutput and the actual finish/result-field helper in a fresh private host-model directory. It recreates real plainJSON and actual finish refusal for an undefined-mutated object, retains the prior typed model bytes/failure record with no result/index/completion, and verifies successful whole result/index/completion publication with the pristine request plus full typed synthetic output bytes. No actual Jco/transpile, component/native API, generated application or guest executes. The private eight-byte synthetic core header is retained as DATA and never compiled/instantiated.
